Source contracts: src/agent_runtime/skill_configuration.py

src/agent_runtime/skill_configuration.py

Python · Tier A

Validate source-declared installation Skill configuration and store it in the shared settings namespace. Full replacements, object patches and resets use settings revisions; defaults and schema callbacks remain code-owned. Secret fields retain Parameter Store references, while private resolution records use without performing transport. The live settings facade can be RAM-backed; standalone SQL is its separate persistence implementation.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
ConfigurationField 28 Small UI vocabulary; paths are relative to the containing entry.
SkillConfigurationDefinition 51 Source-owned versioned schema, defaults and editor fields with optional canonicalization, status and connection-test callbacks. Callback objects are excluded from public serialization; runtime stores use this contract rather than accepting arbitrary provider schemas from clients.
SkillConfigurationDefinition.validate 66 Validate JSON serializability and a 64 KiB encoded bound, check the declared schema, canonicalize a deep copy, then recheck version, schema, size and secret-reference shapes. Return canonical configuration or a value-safe diagnostic; Parameter Store existence is checked separately when saving.
CredentialReference 136 Safe Parameter Store identifier + exact JSON Pointer, never a value.
resolve_credential_reference 148 Resolve an exact normalized Parameter Store entry and JSON Pointer to a nonempty string of at most 16384 characters, record its use, and return the private value. Missing entries/fields and invalid values raise. Transport policy belongs to the adapter: url is accepted by this interface but is not inspected here, and resolution makes no network request.
SkillConfigurationStore 175 Validated facade over AgentUiSettingsStore, without another database/table.
SkillConfigurationStore.load 185 Return validated saved configuration or validated source defaults for an absent/reset entry, preserving its revision. Reject incompatible stored versions or invalid content; the API may display defaults with a repair warning without silently overwriting that saved entry.
SkillConfigurationStore.save 215 Validate a complete replacement and its existing credential references, then atomically increment the settings entry revision with an optional expected-revision check. Save canonical data and a UTC timestamp, returning a detached copy; no connection test is performed.
SkillConfigurationStore.patch 236 Inside the atomic settings update, compare the required revision, recursively merge object changes and replace arrays/scalars, then validate the whole result and references. Omitted fields survive; successful patches publish one new revision and timestamp.
SkillConfigurationStore.reset 260 Revision-check and publish a reset marker, then return the source defaults with the incremented revision. The marker preserves concurrency history instead of deleting the entry; default validation occurs after this settings update.
SkillConfigurationStore._check_references 280 Walk configured secret-reference fields and repeated entries, checking exact Parameter Store identity and bounded nonempty string values without copying secrets into configuration. Missing or unusable references abort the save/patch.
merge_configuration 323 Deep-copy an object and recursively merge object-valued patches while replacing arrays and scalar values wholesale. Reject a non-object patch; null is a replacement value, not an implicit deletion operation.
configuration_metadata 339 Return configurable/version/status metadata without endpoint or credential values. Load and validate configuration locally, call its source-declared status callback if present, and report invalid for ValueError/KeyError; other callback failures propagate. No test callback is invoked.
